injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.detail: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Grayson Allen
injuries.detail: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) won't play Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.detail: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.detail: Smith (illness) is probable for Monday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (illness) is questionable for Monday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.detail: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.detail: Tyson (ankle) is probable for Monday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.detail: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Pascal Siakam
injuries.detail: Siakam is questionable for Monday's game against Oklahoma City due to left hip injury management, according to the NBA's injury report.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.detail: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to left hamstring soreness.

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.detail: Reaves (heel) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Jazz, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.detail: Boozer (ankle) won't play Monday's game against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.detail: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Zion Williamson
injuries.detail: Williamson (thigh) is probable for Monday's game against Phoenix.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.detail: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.detail: Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

injuries.name: Aday Mara
injuries.detail: Mara (shin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Alex Caruso
injuries.detail: Caruso (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.detail: Brown (hamstring) is listed as probable for Monday's game versus Portland.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid (knee) has been downgraded to questionable for Monday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Dean Wade
injuries.detail: Wade (hamstring) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) is listed as probable for Monday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Victor Wembanyama
injuries.detail: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday's game against the Kings, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.detail: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.detail: Fox is questionable for Monday's game against the Kings due to a right shin contusion, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jordan McLaughlin
injuries.detail: McLaughlin (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: RJ Barrett
injuries.detail: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
injuries.detail: Murray-Boyles (concussion) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jaden Bradley
injuries.detail: Bradley is questionable for Monday's game against the Bucks due to an ankle sprain, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.detail: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.
